Maya Patel: Heads upNorAm Utilities RFP. They want an on-prem, air-gapped POC in a locked GovCloud site. Requirements: signed bundles + SBOM, offline license activation, HSM/KMS via PKCS#11, delta updates, quarterly upgrade cadence (<=90 days), minimal USB transfers, and pricing for 1yr reserved support + packaging fee. Security questionnaire link: <https://files.redwood.com/nau/sec-q-2026.pdf>

Ethan Liu: couple quick Qs 1) hardware target? A100 v4 / H100 / CPU-only? 2) will they provide a jumpbox for staging? 3) HSM details (model, PKCS11 path)?

Maya Patel: They're on A100 v4 racks, will provide a hardened jumpbox, and their HSM is Thales Luna (PKCS#11). They prefer reduced physical media movement.

Samir Khan: That maps to our offline flow. We can provide signed tarballs + signed activation artifacts. High-level: produce signed bundle -> customer uploads to jumpbox -> bootstrap validates signature -> signed activation file provisioned by Redwood ops used to unlock local license & write sealed keys to HSM. We support PKCS#11 integration in the bootstrap.

Samir Khan: Sample bootstrap snippet: ```bash
redwood-bootstrap --bundle /jump/bundles/redwood-2026-03.tar.gz \\
  --activation /jump/activation/nau-0001.sig \\
  --hsm-module /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so --hsm-slot 1
```
This validates signatures and seals keys into the HSM.

Julie Park: Security checklist: we need to deliver SBOM (CycloneDX), signed SBOM attestation, CVE remediation policy for the POC, and acceptable pen-test windows. Quarterly patches ok but call out emergency CVE fast-track. For cert rotation: we can do signed rotation packages; default rotation 180 days, but can match 90 on request (ops burden rises). Need NAU SOC contacts for the appendix.

Ethan Liu: To reduce USBs, recommend delta diffs (signed binary diffs). We can provide a single jumpbox workflow: ops will pull signed bundles from their internal registry, run bootstrap. For zero-outbound requirement: we'll generate an activation file that they upload; we have a manual signing step today (ops generates activation sig).

DeployBot: Uploaded artifact: https://artifacts.redwood.com/offline/bundles/redwood-offline-sample-2026-03.tar.gz (signed). SHA256: 3f7e1a9b...b1c9

Maya Patel: Procurement asked for a price skeleton: 1yr reserved on-prem support + airgap packaging fee + engineering time for activation automation. Can someone toss a ballpark together? They want numbers this afternoon.

Ethan Liu: I'll draft two SOW options: Standard POC (quarterly signed deltas, remote support during windows) and Managed POC (we provide jumpbox automation + 24/7 on-call first 90 days). Ballpark: Standard = reserved support + fixed packaging fee + $3,000/mo per rack for support (placeholder). Managed = Standard + $25k onboarding + 2 FTE-months of engineering + higher on-call rate. I'll refine after PM signoff.

Samir Khan: Note enterprise blocker: offline activation currently requires a manual ops process to mint activation signatures. If customer wants automated timed renewals against an HSM without outbound calls, we need a funded eng project (~2 sprints) to build a certificate vending/renewal tool that creates signed activation bundles offline. Call this out in SOW as optional engineering work.

Julie Park: I'll prepare the security appendix (SBOM format, signing key rotation cadence, pen-test scope). Need NAU's SOC/IR contacts and their approved audit windows to schedule testing.

Maya Patel: Can we do a 30min sync with NorAm infra + security tomorrow 10am ET? I'll send calendar invite once SOW draft and security appendix are ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
